steps.what: Select orientation or in-service education programs and agree practical arrangements
Conduct orientation or in-service education and respond to learner questions

tasks.design: Keep programme selection, arrangements and teaching human, using {DOCS} and existing {CALENDAR}. Test native scheduling first if repeated appointment entry is separately measured; no unobserved reminder-writing baseline is added.
tasks.previous_blocker: Appropriate education and timing depend on service and learner needs.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing calendars support arrangements without replacing selection or teaching.
tasks.still_hard: Adapting instruction to actual staff understanding.
tasks.human_edge: Judging learning needs and responding to questions in context.

evidence.claim: Selection, practical negotiation and live teaching remain human without an observed separate clerical step.

assumptions: Boundary covers technician selection, arrangement and delivery; trainee attendance and any formal certification decisions retain their own time.

Participants provide availability during s1 and learner questions during s2. Technician interprets needs and confirms arrangements; no machine assumes a free availability, competence or eligibility flag.
Native calendar configuration is checked first if a scheduling burden is identified.
No new tool or capture obligation means zero incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Is there separately measured duplicate scheduling entry beyond necessary agreement?

already_counted.description: Programme selection, arrangements and live education

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Calendar runtime and trainee attendance create no new focal saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify recipe ingredients, quantities, preparation state and analysis requirements
Analyze recipe quantities and calculate nutrient totals per yield and portion
Evaluate recipe analysis and explain limitations or changes requiring practical testing

tasks.design: For the recipe-analysis branch, test a native calculator in {OTHER}, a nutrition planning system, using checked ingredient mappings. Produce numerical totals from the captured recipe, then retain human interpretation; practical standardisation and product testing keep their separate time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated nutrient and portion calculations can be mixed with ingredient checking.
tasks.enabler_now: Food composition data and fixed quantity calculations can support repeatable analysis.
tasks.still_hard: Preparation, yield and substitutions affect whether the calculation represents the actual food.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising when recipe data needs practical confirmation or dietitian review.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated arithmetic while retaining food and nutrition interpretation.

reach.task: Review limits of a calculated recipe analysis

evidence.claim: NEVO-online supplies food composition data; it does not establish the suitability or actual yield of a local recipe.
Configured recipe arithmetic over checked mappings is plausible, with unmeasured local savings.

assumptions: Boundary is recipe analysis, not a combined saving on physical standardisation or new-product tests. Individual menu planning and its capture remain separately owned; shared work is assigned once in roll-up.

Technician in s1 reads the recipe and captures recipe ID/version, ingredient IDs, composition-data version, quantities and units, preparation state, measured or stated yield, portion definition and analysis scope. Capture and mapping checks retain 35 hours; missing or unmatched foods return to manual clarification.
Composition database publishes nutrient values per reference quantity and units. Calculator uses those with checked mappings, never a free allergy-safety or clinical-suitability flag.
Native calculation is tested first; existing automatic recipe arithmetic earns no saving.
unknowns: Reliability of yield and ingredient mappings
research_questions: Does repeated arithmetic remain removable after ingredient capture and yield checking?

already_counted.description: Recipe capture, mapping checks and analysis interpretation

incremental.description: Maintain composition mappings and calculation examples

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+0+35=70, gross=30, focal upkeep=7, net=23. Range 0-5 assumes repeated manual arithmetic on mapped recipes; existing calculators or uncertain yields remove the gain.

tasks.short: Determine food costs and assist cost control

steps.what: Verify food and beverage quantities, purchase costs and cost allocation assumptions
Determine food and beverage costs using the checked calculation rules
Review food costs and assist staff in implementing agreed cost control procedures

tasks.design: Configure protected costing formulas in {SPREADSHEET} before custom code, using records checked from {ERP}. Keep cost interpretation and assistance with implementation human; calculated differences do not trigger automatic purchasing or menu changes.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated unit conversion and cost arithmetic can require manual spreadsheet work.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed costing formulas can recalculate explicit quantities and allocation assumptions.
tasks.still_hard: Purchase units, waste and actual consumption may differ from nominal recipe costs.
tasks.human_edge: Explaining meaningful cost differences and practical constraints on control measures.
tasks.altitude: Less arithmetic with unchanged advisory cost-control scope.

reach.task: Discuss nutrition tradeoffs in cost control
reach.learn: Unit costs, allocations and practical service constraints

evidence.claim: Configured cost arithmetic over checked purchases and quantities is plausible; local savings remain an E1 estimate.

assumptions: Boundary covers technician cost determination and implementation assistance, excluding purchasing decisions, staff execution and nutrition approval of changes.

Purchasing and kitchen staff produce purchase and quantity records in ordinary work. Technician in s1 captures item ID, period, quantity/unit, pack conversion, unit price, discounts, currency, tax treatment, yield/waste assumptions and allocation basis; checking and manual extraction retain 35 hours.
Missing consumption or conversion data is clarified manually or shown as unknown; no free par level, discrepancy code or validated actual cost is assumed.
Native ERP costing and existing protected formulas are tested first; existing automated runtime earns no labour saving.
research_questions: Does repeated costing arithmetic remain after native features and full input checking?

already_counted.description: Cost input capture, interpretation and implementation assistance

incremental.description: Maintain costing rules and conversion checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+0+30=65, gross=35, focal upkeep=8, net=27. Range 0-6 assumes repeated manual costing; existing ERP calculations or missing consumption data remove the gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Deliver speeches on diet, nutrition and health and respond to audience questions

tasks.design: Keep speech delivery and audience interaction human, using checked material in {DOCS}. Native presentation access supports delivery; separate content drafting requires its own observed baseline before claiming savings.
tasks.previous_blocker: Effective education depends on audience understanding and clear explanation.
tasks.enabler_now: Digital material supports delivery without replacing live communication.
tasks.still_hard: Responding appropriately when a general audience asks an individual health question.
tasks.human_edge: Adapting explanations and recognising questions that need specialist input.
tasks.altitude: Public education responsibility and time remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Accessible nutrition communication and referral limits

evidence.claim: Live health education remains human; supplied clinical documentation cases do not establish savings in speech delivery.

assumptions: Boundary is delivery and live response, not creation of educational material or individual clinical advice. Overlapping staff education delivery must be assigned once in roll-up.

Technician or supervising dietitian prepares checked material in separate existing work before s1; audience questions arise during delivery. No new machine assumes a free approved health-claim dataset or audience-understanding flag.
Existing native presentation access is the first option if retrieval issues emerge.
No new tool or capture obligation means zero incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Is there a distinct repetitive preparation task beyond live delivery?

already_counted.description: Live speech delivery and audience response

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Live delivery retains all time and separate drafting savings are not imported.
